title: sideroxylon eriocarpum
intro: Sideroxylon eriocarpum, commonly known as the Black Ironwood, is a plant species within the Sapotaceae family. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Sideroxylon eriocarpum include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
